correctness.rationale: The cyclic predecessor criterion is a four-pair-state closed-walk test. Exhaustive generation of all 75 reachable Boolean relations gives an exact finite transfer. Initial coefficient identities and 75 consecutive integer recurrence residuals, combined with Cayley-Hamilton, prove the all-n rational formula. The factorization, pole coefficient, and subdominant root bounds are algebraic; a separately coded cyclic brute-force enumerator agrees for every n from 1 to 18.

value.rationale: The distinct output count and unreachable-output count are natural all-length invariants of a classical computationally universal binary cellular automaton. The rational function determines every indexed cyclic ring size, the spatial one-step image entropy, and exact leading exponential coefficient. It replaces isolated finite tables with a nontrivial structural transfer certificate and is distinct from individual-target preimage counts.
